WITH DailyBalances AS (
    -- Step 1: Calculate daily running balance for each customer
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS daily_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
RollingAverages AS (
    -- Step 2: Compute 30-day rolling average, starting after 30 days of data
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) >= 30 THEN
                GREATEST(0, AVG(daily_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
            ELSE 0
        END AS rolling_avg_balance
    FROM DailyBalances
),
